run: vitest single fork, DB env unset, 2026-10-04

tests.test: V1 — on_unknown:"fail" turns a stored value outside the declared set into a FAIL gate row
V2 — on_unknown:"warn" reports the same unknowns as a WARN gate row, never a FAIL
V3 — on_unknown:"quarantine" takes the strictest arm (FAIL) until an executor exists
V4 — a column whose every stored value is declared reads INFO with its distinct count
V5 — SQL shape: exactly one DISTINCT read, for the vocabulary column only
V6 — outputs:"none" yields no rows and runs no statement
V7 — the four real descriptors declare their vocabularies as OBJECTS with on_unknown:"fail"
V8 — runWithPool calls write.vocabularyRows AFTER compute and folds it into extraRows
